caption: Original instrumental cinematic ambient space-station horror underscore, restrained and unnervingly quiet, no voices, no choir, no drums, no song beat. Dark bowed metal, slowly changing low string friction, distant fragile glass harmonics, dry structural creaks and soft sub-bass pressure beneath wide empty air. An abandoned industrial habitat, believable physical space rather than fantasy. Begin almost empty with breathing room between small sounds; gradually introduce an uneasy dissonant bowed-metal layer in the middle; develop toward a more urgent tightly restrained tremolo texture late in the piece, without a percussion groove or loud stingers; recede into a suspended unresolved quiet ending. Sparse, evolving, detailed acoustic-electroacoustic timbres, long restrained resonances, controlled transients, warm low-mid weight, headphone-friendly dynamic range, no sudden explosive accents, no heroic melody.
